title: Stop Guessing! Master Agentic Context Management & Deterministic Evals with Tessl 🤖
description:
If you’re building with autonomous agents, you know that managing context is currently more of an art than a science—tedious, imprecise, and hard to scale. It’s time to stop just "sharing markdown documents" and start treating context as a first-class primitive in your software stack.

In this video, we dive into how Tessl is revolutionizing the agentic coding ecosystem by allowing you to version, share, and rigorously evaluate your agent's context. We break down the three essential types of evals you need to ensure your LLMs are actually improving:

• Task Evals: Measuring specific agent behavior changes with and without your context.

• Skill Review: Automated "skill linting" based on SOTA best practices from leaders like Anthropic.

• Repo Evals: Generating realistic scenarios from recent commit history to see how your agent fares in production-like environments.

We also tackle the challenge of LLM non-determinism and how to handle variance and outliers to get clean, actionable scores. Don't let your context stay "just markdown"—start evaluating it today.


🔗 Get started for free: tessl.io/registry

Key Topics Covered:
• Why context management is currently "vibes-based".
• The 3-pillar eval framework: Task, Skill, and Repo.
• Benchmarking agent behavior in real-world environments.
• Solving the non-deterministic nature of LLMs.
